adds.title: ASEAN SOGIE Caucus Report November 2017; Human Rights Watch on June 26, 2020 Manila Pride arrests
adds.summary: On June 26, 2020 in Manila police arrested at least 20 participants in an LGBT Pride protest where there were no allegations of violence and participants wore masks and followed social-distancing protocols, subsequently charging them under the 2019 Law on Reporting of Communicable Diseases and the 1985 Public Assembly Act.

adds.title: United Nations joint statement on ending acts of violence and related human rights violations based on sexual orientation and gender identity
adds.summary: On 22 March 2011 Palau joined the Human Rights Council joint statement on ending acts of violence and related human rights violations based on sexual orientation and gender identity, which called on states to end acts of violence, criminal sanctions and related human rights violations committed against individuals because of sexual orientation or gender identity.
